events.title: Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026

events.title: DevFest Bengaluru 2026 (GDG Bangalore)

events.theme: AI (AI Studio, Gemini), Android, Flutter, Google Cloud, Web

events.title: Cloud Community Days × DevFest 2026 Trivandrum

events.title: Huddle Global 2026

events.perks: Product expo, mentor and investor connect (Diamond), lunch and networking

events.fitReason: Very relevant to your goal of building an online business, and it's close by. But the ₹7,000 ticket is a lot for a student, so only go if you find a student or volunteer pass.

events.title: DevFest 2026 (GDG Cloud Bengaluru)

events.title: AI Tools that Earn: Apify Hackathon

events.title: Build with Agora: Voice AI Hackathon
